steps: In Battle Royale, be selected as Jumpmaster (or take control of the drop).
Drop as Jumpmaster in 5 separate matches — the counter is cumulative.
Loot a Fully Kitted (gold) weapon from the Hot Zone, Care Packages, Vaults, Loot Ticks, or fill every attachment slot with legendary parts.
Equip that fully kitted weapon once during a match.
Get at least 3 kills in a match — the first player to reach 3 kills becomes Kill Leader.
Hold Kill Leader for any amount of time (even one second counts).
warnings: Having the most kills below 3 does not count — you must reach 3 kills first.

steps: Pick up a fallen teammate's banner.
Use a Respawn Beacon or Mobile Respawn Beacon to bring them back.

achievements.name: Apex Recon
achievements.description: Win a game as a recon character

steps: Select a Recon Legend (radar icon): Bloodhound, Crypto, Seer, or Vantage.
Win a Battle Royale match as that Legend.

achievements.name: Apex Assault
achievements.description: Win a game as an assault character

steps: Select an Assault Legend (assault icon): Bangalore, Fuse, Ash, Mad Maggie, or Ballistic.
Win a Battle Royale match — the old "Offense" class maps to Assault after the Season 16 rework.

achievements.name: Decked Out
achievements.description: Equip any 2 legendary equipment items at the same time

steps: Loot two legendary (gold) equipment pieces — helmet, body armor, backpack, or knockdown shield.
Equip both at the same time. Best sources: Vaults, Care Packages, legendary Loot Ticks, Cargo Bots, Loot MRVNs.

achievements.name: Apex Support
achievements.description: Win a game as a support character

steps: Select a Support Legend (cross icon): Gibraltar, Lifeline, Mirage, Loba, Newcastle, or Conduit.
Win a Battle Royale match as that Legend.
Play Apex matches across modes — XP and challenges count toward account progress.
Reach the level / badge requirement for this achievement (progress carries between sessions).

achievements.name: Apex Controller
achievements.description: Win a game as a controller character

steps: Select a Controller Legend (controller icon): Caustic, Wattson, Rampart, or Catalyst.
Win a Battle Royale match — this replaced the old Defensive class after Season 16.
warnings: Do not confuse Controller with Support — many former defensive legends moved into Support.

steps: Pick 8 Legends and deal 5,000 damage with each one individually (40,000 total).
Track progress via Legends → Banners → Trackers → Damage Done. Knockdown Shield and Gibraltar Gun Shield damage do not count.

achievements.name: Apex Legend
achievements.description: Win a game with 8 different Legends

steps: Win Battle Royale matches with 8 different Legends (only BR wins count).
Rotate Legends after each win until eight unique Champions are recorded.
